title: Automation Anywhere Bot Deployment
description: Schema representing a bot deployment request and response in the Automation Anywhere Control Room, including deployment configuration, target device specification, input variables, and the resulting deployment identifier.

deploymentId.description: Unique UUID identifier assigned to this deployment instance by the Control Room upon successful dispatch

botId.description: Numeric file ID of the bot to deploy, referencing the bot's ID in the repository

automationName.description: Optional human-readable label for this automation instance as displayed in activity logs and dashboards

description.description: Optional description of this specific deployment for tracking and audit purposes

botLabel.description: Optional label tag for identifying this deployment instance

runElevated.description: Whether to run the bot with elevated system privileges on the Bot Runner device

hideBotAgentUi.description: Whether to suppress the Bot Agent user interface on the runner device during execution

automationPriority.description: Priority level for this automation in the dispatch queue relative to other pending deployments

botInput.description: Runtime input variables to pass to the bot at execution time. Keys are variable names as defined in the bot; values are typed variable objects.

CallbackInfo.description: Webhook callback configuration for receiving execution completion or failure notifications

url.description: HTTPS endpoint URL to POST the execution result notification to upon completion or failure

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to include in the callback POST request (e.g., authorization headers)

BotInputVariable.description: A typed input variable value passed to the bot at deployment time

type.description: Data type of the variable matching its declaration in the bot definition

string.description: String value for variables of type STRING

number.description: Numeric value represented as a string for NUMBER type variables

boolean.description: Boolean value for BOOLEAN type variables

list.description: Structured list value for LIST type variables

dictionary.description: Key-value map for DICTIONARY type variables

UnattendedRequest.description: Configuration for unattended bot execution on Bot Runner devices associated with specified user accounts

runAsUsers.description: User accounts whose associated Bot Runner devices will execute the bot

poolIds.description: Device pool IDs to dispatch the bot to; the Control Room selects an available device from each pool

items.description: Numeric ID of a device pool

AttendedRequest.description: Configuration for attended bot execution on the device of a currently logged-in user

currentUserDeviceId.description: Device ID of the machine where the attended user is currently logged in

HeadlessRequest.description: Configuration for headless bot execution on On-Demand cloud Bot Runner devices

numOfRunAsUsersToUse.description: Number of On-Demand Bot Runner instances to allocate for parallel headless execution

RunAsUser.description: Reference to a user account whose associated Bot Runner device will execute an unattended bot

id.description: Numeric user ID of the run-as user in the Control Room
